invoices.title: Clean approval
invoices.scenario: Metro invoice MFS-908 matches its approved vendor, PO-FAC-101, amount and 18% tax. It is the reference for the later duplicate.

invoices.title: Tax exception
invoices.scenario: Kaveri invoice KPM-331 reports INR 7,000 tax on INR 35,000, while PO-STAT-201 specifies 18% (INR 6,300).

invoices.title: Bundled service invoice
invoices.scenario: PixelCraft invoice PCD-2026-009 uses a different PDF layout for a bundled design sprint against PO-DES-301.

invoices.title: First invoice on a shared PO
invoices.scenario: Blue Lotus invoice BLP-9001 consumes INR 12,000 of the INR 30,000 PO-PACK-401. Later invoices use the same PO.

invoices.title: Valid second invoice on the same PO
invoices.scenario: Blue Lotus invoice BLP-9002 consumes another INR 12,000 of PO-PACK-401, leaving INR 6,000.

invoices.title: PO balance exception
invoices.scenario: Blue Lotus invoice BLP-9003 requests INR 10,000 after the first two invoices, exceeding the remaining PO balance by INR 4,000.

invoices.title: Confirmed duplicate
invoices.scenario: Metro repeats invoice number MFS-908 from the preloaded clean invoice; the duplicate check should reject it.

invoices.title: Scanned invoice with missing number
invoices.scenario: Cedar's PDF is image-only and omits the invoice number. OCR is attempted when available, and the missing field requires review.

invoices.title: Fresh clean upload
invoices.scenario: Blue Lotus invoice BLP-9010 uses separate PO-PACK-402 and shows GST included in the INR 16,000 total.

bank_statement.title: Payment reconciliation
bank_statement.scenario: Five outgoing rows: full Metro and Blue Lotus BLP-9001 payments, partial Kaveri and Blue Lotus BLP-9002 payments, and an unmatched card purchase.
